articles.title: 5 Everyday Habits for a Healthier Heart
articles.excerpt: Small micro-routines like morning zone-2 walking, hydration timing, and sodium balancing can compound into massive cardiovascular resilience.
articles.content: Cardiovascular wellness does not require drastic overnight changes. Incorporating 30 minutes of brisk walking, reducing refined sugars, maintaining consistent sleep cycles (7-8 hours), practicing 5 minutes of slow diaphragmatic breathing, and staying hydrated are the highest ROI daily habits for artery flexibility.

articles.title: Heart-Healthy Diet: What to Eat & What to Avoid
articles.excerpt: Unpacking the Mediterranean-DASH hybrid dietary pattern: rich in polyphenols, omega-3 fatty acids, and soluble dietary fiber.
articles.content: The optimal heart diet emphasizes extra virgin olive oil, wild-caught fatty fish or flaxseed, leafy greens, walnuts, and legumes. Dr. Sharma recommends avoiding ultra-processed trans fats, high-fructose corn syrups, and hidden excess sodium in preserved condiments.

articles.title: Regular Exercise: How Movement Prolongs Cardiac Life
articles.excerpt: How moderate aerobic training increases VO2 max, stimulates nitric oxide vascular dilation, and lowers resting pulse rate.
articles.content: Consistent aerobic exercise strengthens the left ventricle, allowing the heart to pump more blood with each stroke and reducing arterial stiffness. Aim for 150 minutes of moderate-intensity or 75 minutes of vigorous cardiovascular exercise weekly.
